subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a native folder-backed encrypted snapshot and workspace-mirroring flow after the technical blockers are fixed, or should this remain outside core while current main keeps local archive create/verify?
rationale: The PR adds new CLI and config surfaces for backup storage and encryption, which root policy treats as compatibility-sensitive and product-owned rather than an automatic bug fix.

options.title: Sponsor native core backup
options.body: Keep this PR open only if a maintainer wants the native core surface after rebase, hardening, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Narrow to archive restore only
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that completes local archive restore without adding folder snapshot config or workspace mirroring.

options.title: Route off-machine backup outside core
options.body: Close or redirect the folder-backed/off-machine parts to a plugin or ClawHub package if core should stay limited to local archives.

recommendation.title: Sponsor native core backup
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if a maintainer wants the native core surface after rebase, hardening, and real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He recently merged current-main backup security hardening and is the clearest available routing owner for the core/product decision.
